findings.message: The blanket SPDX annotation applies AGL-1.1 to every path, including assets/logo.jpg and assets/social-preview.png. AegeanWorks' ASSET_POLICY.md classifies logos and branding as all rights reserved, so the machine-readable metadata grants rights the policy withholds; assets/** needs its own all-rights-reserved notice or LicenseRef.

The manifest lists code and the favicon but not the shipped brand images under assets/ (logo.jpg, social-preview.png), even though the README displays the banner and the repo carries both. Under LICENSE 1.2 unlisted assets stay proprietary, so the status should be stated explicitly once the REUSE annotation is corrected.
